## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Per-issue mutation dedup — issue appearing on two pages mid-fetch yields exactly one mutation tuple

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test asserts dedup alert kind fetcher-dedup-suppressed
  Verify: grep -F 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py
- [ ] Test stages duplicate key across two pages
  Verify: grep -E 'DIG-100' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py
- [ ] Test references alert_store
  Verify: grep -F 'alert_store' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py
- [ ] Test fails against current fetcher.py (RED confirmation)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py; [ $? -ne 0 ]

## TDD Test Spec
Given ACLI stub where DIG-100 appears on both page 1 and page 2; When collect() runs to completion; Then snapshot contains DIG-100 exactly once AND exactly one BRIDGE_ALERT of kind 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed' referencing DIG-100 is written via alert_store.py.

## Implementation Notes
- Create tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py
- page 1 = [DIG-1..DIG-100], page 2 = [DIG-100, DIG-101..DIG-199]
- monkeypatch alert_store output dir to tmp_path
- Assert len(snapshot) == 199, DIG-100 appears once
- Assert exactly one BRIDGE_ALERT file with kind 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed' for DIG-100

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED: per-issue dedup with BRIDGE_ALERT observable
